summary: Coca-Cola Europacific Partners plc filed a US-equivalent Form 6-K confirming open-market repurchases of 253,196 ordinary shares (180,000 on US venues, 73,196 on London venues) between 21 and 25 September 2026, executed through Goldman Sachs at volume-weighted averages near USD 100.94 and GBP 75.95. The buys fall under the buyback programme announced 17 February 2026, authorising up to EUR 1 billion in aggregate repurchases, with shares to be cancelled. No board recommendation or premium applies. Watch execution pace against the EUR 1 billion cap and any liquidity or overhang effects on the Nasdaq and London lines.
